notes.title: Update 1.1 - Variety and Stability
notes.content: [p][b]Hello and thank you for playing RotorSim! This update adds building and sound variety, increases stability, and fixes several significant bugs that have been reported since the game's launch. I hope this improves your experience! As always, visit the discord to submit ideas or fixes.[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]The original building artist, Elegant Crow, has returned and made additional structures which are included in the world to make it all more interesting.[/p][/*][*][p]Several repetitive sounds (such as impacts and yells) now have more variety and some tweaks to make them less boring.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the "Realistic Loading" toggle to actually work. Enable this setting and your passengers will politely wait until you have shut down your rotors to run into your helicopter. This won't work on rescue missions.[/p][/*][*][p]Citizens that need to be picked up via the rescue gantry now show a different symbol when approaching them to make it more clear what kind of pickup they are.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the accidental win conditions for certain cargo missions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some menu inconsistencies while using a gamepad; you are now able to select all the game settings in the pause menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized signal and damage smoke particles to be less demanding - a bit less impressive but lower end computers are far less likely to melt :)[/p][/*][*][p]Various small optimizations and tweaks to improve your time in the game.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support and stay tuned for more updates![/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content: [p][b]Hi folks, here is a quick patch based on immediate user feedback. The goal is to improve some immediate quality of life issues so I can focus on larger fixes and updates in the future. I hope this improves your experience! As always, visit the discord to submit ideas or fixes.[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Added a "Realistic Loading Conditions" toggle on the Mission Select screen. With this enabled, passengers will run over and jump in ONLY if the engine is shut off. Rescue missions remain unaffected.[/p][/*][*][p]Extended the time the mission end text is displayed so you can read the whole message [/p][/*][*][p]Made sure rescue missions always utilize the gantry system instead of a full landing (mission objectives have been adjusted to keep this consistent)[/p][/*][*][p]Reverted custom mouse icon so it scales properly with large screens[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed menu and controller UI issues[/p][/*][*][p]Various typo fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Future Plans:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Additional graphics options[/p][/*][*][p]Expanding citizen reactions and poses[/p][/*][*][p]Control enhancements[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support and stay tuned for more updates![/p]
